_Are you a passionate jewellery designer with extensive experience creating iconic products and collections? Do you have a strong creative vision, exceptional sketching abilities, and a deep understanding of craftsmanship, materials, and the jewellery design process? Would you like to shape the future of Pandora's Modern Classics & Diamonds category by creating innovative designs that combine timeless elegance with modern expression?

__**Lead creative projects that define the future of Pandora's most iconic collections

**_As our new Senior Designer, Modern Classics & Diamonds, you will work closely with the Design Director to lead creative projects from initial concept generation through design execution and prototype development. Utilizing your strong creative skills, technical expertise, and deep understanding of Pandora's brand DNA, you will play a key role in developing compelling collections that inspire customers around the world.

**Your Role

****Design & Collection Development

**

• Partner with the team to create and develop new collections within the Modern Classics & Diamonds category.

• Translate creative briefs into innovative product concepts, designs, and sketches that align with Pandora's brand identity.

• Lead individual design projects from initial research and concept development through CAD and prototype stages.

• Propose original and future-thinking product ideas that support the strategic direction of the category.

• Ensure projects are developed and launched within agreed timelines and project requirements.

• Review and provide comprehensive feedback on CADs within agreed timeframes.

• Develop creative mood boards, concept presentations, creative sketches, and technical drawings to support product development.

• Brief products to Design Operations & Development (DoD) and collaborate closely to ensure successful prototype execution.

• Review early prototypes and provide feedback ahead of formal prototype review sessions.

• Support prototype reviews and creative evaluations when required.

• Collaborate with Creative Sourcing to explore new materials, techniques, and innovation opportunities.

• Partner with Creative Merchandising to align category and collection structures.

• Ensure legal documentation and inspiration references are provided within agreed timelines.

• Maintain accurate design documentation, presentations, folders, and project records throughout the design process.

• Support and mentor Junior Designers, providing guidance on both creative and technical aspects of their work.

**Research & Innovation

**

• Conduct research projects based on briefs from Creative Leadership.

• Participate in research trips to identify emerging trends, products, techniques, materials, and creative inspiration.

• Translate research findings into strong creative concepts and collection ideas.

• Contribute to the development of new concepts, innovation opportunities, and future category directions.

• Ensure all research, concept development, reviews, and launches are delivered according to agreed timelines and processes.

• Update design presentations with relevant concepts, sketches, and final designs throughout project development.

**A Creative Visionary with a Passion for Jewellery Design

**You might be the person we are looking for if you combine exceptional creativity with strong technical expertise and an eye for commercial product design. You are skilled at transforming inspiration into compelling jewellery concepts and are comfortable working across all stages of the design process, from initial idea generation to final product execution.

You understand how to balance innovation with brand consistency and have a proven ability to create products that strengthen and evolve an established global brand. You enjoy working collaboratively in a fast-paced international environment and thrive when bringing new ideas to life.

**Requirements

**

• Extensive experience designing jewellery within a fashion, luxury, or jewellery brand.

• Strong creative portfolio demonstrating concept development, mood boards, sketches, and finished products.

• Proven experience leading design projects from concept to prototype.

• Advanced knowledge of jewellery design and manufacturing processes.

• Strong hand-sketching and visual communication skills.

• Experience working with CAD development and cross-functional product development teams.

• Ability to translate creative direction into commercially successful products.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills.

• Experience mentoring or supporting junior designers is an advantage.

• Proficiency in relevant design tools such as Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign.

**Important

**Please include a portfolio showcasing your design work, creative process, technical skills, and collection development experience as part of your application.

**Your New Team

**As a key member of Pandora's Product Design team, you will join an international group of passionate, ambitious, and highly skilled designers dedicated to creating beautiful and innovative jewellery. You will report to the Design Director and collaborate closely with colleagues across Creative Direction, Design Operations & Development, Creative Merchandising, Creative Sourcing, and Product Development.

**Additional Information

**This role is based at Pandora's Global Office in Copenhagen, Denmark.

**Did We Get Your Attention?

**If you see yourself in this position and would like to become part of Pandora's future, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please submit your CV and portfolio through our online application system. We look forward to hearing from you.

We process applications on an ongoing basis and therefore encourage you to submit your application at your earliest convenience. You can read more about Pandora on our corporate website Pandora Group.

**Icing on the Cake

**You will be working from our beautiful Global Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. Alongside our inspiring work environment, we are proud to hold LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design, reflecting our commitment to sustainability and responsible use of resources.

The result is a professional and dynamic workspace that is unique, comfortable, and inspirational, delivering a true Pandora experience to everyone who works here and visits our offices.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

**_Ready to build the AI engine behind the world's largest jewellery brand?

_**As Lead AI Platform Engineer, you will be the technical force behind Pandora's AI platform, shaping how AI systems are built, scaled, and secured across the business. Combining deep hands-on engineering expertise with strong technical leadership, you will drive architectural excellence, elevate engineering standards, and deliver reliable, production-ready AI solutions at scale.

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Be To

****Technical Leadership

**

• Serve as the technical lead for the AI platform engineering team — setting the implementation direction, defining coding standards, and making key technical decisions that govern how the platform is built and evolved.

• Lead code reviews and drive architecture discussions, ensuring engineering decisions are well-reasoned, documented, and aligned with the broader platform strategy — championing engineering standards across code quality, testing practices, documentation, observability, and security hardening.

• Act as a technical mentor and go-to resource for all engineers — sharing knowledge, unblocking complex problems, and actively investing in the technical growth of both senior and junior team members.

**Platform Engineering & AI Infrastructure

**

• Design, build, and operate scalable, high-performance services and platform components that expose AI/ML capabilities across Pandora's digital ecosystem.

• Own and define the standards and governance for Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code (IaC) — ensuring all Azure infrastructure is reproducible, auditable, and securely configured.

• Apply strong network architecture knowledge to design and govern secure connectivity between platform services, AI gateways, and external integrations, including VNet, private endpoints, NSGs, and ingress/egress controls, while collaborating with security stakeholders to uphold the platform's overall security posture.

• Leverage Databricks for big data processing, feature engineering, and ML pipeline support.

**AI Services & Agentic Development

**

• Integrate and operationalise AI services including LLM APIs, vector search, RAG pipelines, embeddings, and multi-layer caching into platform-level services.

• Lead the agentic code development practice: architecting autonomous execution loops that enable tools like Claude Code and GitHub Copilot to safely write, test, and self-correct software within isolated sandboxes.

• Own MLflow governance standards for experiment tracking, model versioning, and ML lifecycle management across the team.

• Configure and manage AI gateways to ensure secure, scalable, and governed access to AI capabilities at production scale.

**CI/CD & Reliability

**

• Define and govern the CI/CD standards for the AI platform team — establishing quality gates, testing frameworks, deployment patterns, and pipeline architecture that all engineers build to.

• Ensure performance, availability, and maintainability of platform services in production; handle incidents in a timely manner to minimise Mean Time to Contain (MTTC).

**Job Requirements

****Education & Experience

**

• Relevant background from Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field with experience in backend or platform engineering, with at least 2 years operating in a technical leadership capacity within AI or cloud-native platform teams.

• Proven experience building and operating AI/ML platform services or LLM-based integrations in a production environment.

**Technical Skills

**

• Strong backend engineering fundamentals: service architecture, REST API design, performance optimisation, and production reliability by design and monitoring, with hands-on proficiency in Python.

• Deep Kubernetes expertise — workload configuration, networking, security policy design, and production debugging; hands-on Docker and Azure App Services.

• Expert-level Terraform and IaC ownership — defining standards, patterns, and governance for cloud infrastructure on Azure.

• Strong network architecture and configuration skills, including Azure networking concepts (VNet, NSG, private endpoints, DNS, ingress/egress).

• MLflow governance, Databricks for ML pipeline integration, and experience with ML serving infrastructure, LLM APIs, prompt integration, and multi-layer caching.

• Proficiency in PostgreSQL and experience in configuring AI gateways for centralized AI governance

• Experience in agentic code development practice, harness engineering and spec-driven development is a plus.

**Soft Skills

**Ideally you are a trusted technical leader who combines strong engineering expertise with clear thinking and a collaborative approach to drive sound decisions, communicate complex platform, security, and architecture topics in a business-friendly way, and foster team growth. Brings a proactive and curious mindset, with a passion for emerging AI technologies balanced by a pragmatic focus on execution and delivery.

**About The Team

**You will be part of Pandora's AI Platform team within AI CoE at Digital & Analytics & AI — a passionate, forward-thinking group dedicated to building the infrastructure and services that bring AI to life across the business. The team works at the intersection of data science, machine learning, cloud engineering, and product development, collaborating closely with ML Engineers, Data Scientists, AI Architects, and Product stakeholders.

You will report to the AI Platform Manager and serve as the senior technical voice that shapes how the platform is designed, secured, and evolved — influencing both what gets built and how it gets built.

**Did we get your attention?

**We hope you got all your questions answered and feel confident applying for this position. If you see yourself in the role and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply! We are an international team, so please make sure to send us your application in English to be considered. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com.

**Icing on the cake

**You will be working out of our beautiful Digital & Technology Hub in Copenhagen, in a rapidly growing environment of highly skilled and experienced colleagues, which is a key initiative that goes along with Pandora’s experience & ambitions.Besides our beautiful interior design, we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable and inspirational – and delivers a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

Some jobs teach you a skill. This one teaches you how to grow. We are looking for a curious, driven Business Development Representative to own outbound in Sweden, part time, from our Copenhagen office.

Who we are

Cludo is a Danish tech company that builds AI powered, intelligent search for content rich websites. The way we all search has changed: we no longer want a list of links, we expect a direct answer. Cludo gives website visitors exactly that, a modern search experience that understands what they are looking for and answers them directly.For communication, marketing and web teams, Cludo is also a platform for insight. They see what their users search for, spot the gaps and use those insights to keep improving both their content and the search experience. Organizations across Europe and beyond trust us to do this, guided by our four values: Growth, Passion, Reason and Sincerity.

Why business development matters here

Business development is the engine of Cludo. Most of our new growth starts with a conversation a BDR opened, which makes this team central to the success of the whole company. It is also one of the few places where you see your impact straight away. In sales you never have to wonder whether you are doing well: the numbers tell you, every single week.

The role: own outbound in Sweden

We opened the Swedish market three years ago, and the foundations are in place: real customers, real references and a proven playbook. Now we are looking for someone to pick up that momentum and own outbound in Sweden. You will work in tandem with our Swedish Account Executive. You open the doors and build the pipeline; they take the opportunities forward to close. Together, you are responsible for growing the Swedish market. Our focus segments are the public sector, higher education, regions, banks and insurance companies.

This is a part time role of around 15 to 20 hours per week, built to fit around your studies. Your hours are flexible, but we want you in our Copenhagen office for most of them, because that is where the learning, the energy and the team are. You report to Matteo Pasquato, who leads our Global BDR team.

What you'll be doing

• 
Own the outbound motion in Sweden, from building target lists to booking the first meeting

• 
Research organizations across the public sector, higher education, regions, banking and insurance, and find the right people to talk to

• 
Start real conversations by phone, email and LinkedIn, and turn curiosity into meetings

• 
Use AI to work smarter and faster: research accounts, find the right organizations and people, and personalize your outreach so every message lands

• 
Qualify opportunities and hand them to your Account Executive with the context they need to win

• 
Plan campaigns together with your AE and adjust them based on what the numbers tell you

• 
Support marketing initiatives in Sweden, both digital and in person

Who you are

Your background matters less than your mindset. We care more about who you are becoming than about what is already on your CV.

• 
Curious. You ask questions, dig deeper and want to understand how things work. The more curious you are, the faster you learn.

• 
Eager to learn. You want to become a better version of yourself every day, and you see feedback as fuel.

• 
Driven. You set goals, chase them and take ownership of your results.

• 
Resilient and consistent. A no does not slow you down for long. You show up with the same energy on the hard days as on the good ones.

• 
Fluent in Swedish and strong in English, both written and spoken.

• 
Organized and analytical, with a love for figuring things out.

A big plus

An additional language beyond Swedish and English. We are continuously experimenting in new markets, so every extra language opens doors, for you and for us. Bonus points too if you have done outreach or customer facing work before, or already know your way around the Swedish public sector.

The team you join

You join Cludo's BDR team: multicultural, made up of people from different countries and backgrounds, and set to grow in number over the coming years. We are the most active, and probably the loudest, team at Cludo. High energy, high tempo.

Three words sum up what we stand for: fresh, energetic and inspirational. Expect shared wins, honest feedback and teammates who pick you up when you need it.

The honest part

This role is not easy. Outbound sales is a game of consistency, and there will be ups and downs: weeks where everything clicks and weeks where nothing seems to land.

What matters is what you do with the downs. Every no teaches you something, and you will never have to figure it out alone. Your manager and your team are there to coach you, back you and help you turn setbacks into progress.

What you take with you

The BDR role is a talent factory and a starting point, not a destination. It is a great first step for any career, whatever your background. The skills you build here, from communication and resilience to structure and discipline, will serve you in your professional life and your private life alike. Whether your next step is in sales or somewhere else entirely, you will carry what you learn here with you.

What we offer

• 
Real impact from day one in a fun, informal and creative environment

• 
Flexible hours that fit around your studies and schedule

• 
A commitment to work life balance, proudly Danish style

• 
A front row seat to see how a tech company scales

• 
A bright, buzzing office in Copenhagen, with daily lunch from our amazing kitchen crew

• 
Onsite perks like a motion room, sauna, winter bathing access and kayaks (yes, really)

• 
Cold dips and breakfast with the team every Friday morning

How we hire

• 
Apply.

• 
First interview. Meet Matteo, Ville (our VP of Sales) and a few of your future teammates (about 1.5 hours).

• 
Culture and context. Wrap up with a conversation with Tina, our Scandinavian AE.

Curious? Apply, and let's see where you get.

Cludo is transforming the way organizations build relationships with their customers by easily connecting them to relevant content. We make it easier for visitors to find relevant information via a more natural and intuitive guided website search experience. Headquartered in Copenhagen, we are an ambitious and customer-focused international team. Join us today and help us scale to the next level of success! Every employee at Cludo has the ability to bring meaningful work to their job. We are in a unique company stage where everyone contributes to the business in a positive way, driven by our values of Growth, Passion, Reason, and Sincerity. We want individuals to join our team for the right reasons and feel it’s important to find people who want to contribute and help us scale up! We are a company that encourages direct feedback and celebrate wins together to get our company to the next level of success. If you are looking for a career that will challenge you to be a better professional while enjoying some great perks – you’re in the right place!

General information

Operation Manager

Do you thrive in a dynamic environment where customer focus, operational excellence, and technical expertise go hand in hand? We are looking for an experienced Operations Manager Service to join our Global Service organization.

This is an exciting opportunity for a technically skilled professional who enjoys working closely with customers while driving operational excellence. As Operations Manager Service, you will play a key role in ensuring successful execution of service projects, maintaining strong customer relationships, and contributing to the continued development of our service business.

Your Role

As Operations Manager Service, you will be responsible for the daily operational management of service activities and projects. Acting as the primary point of contact for our customers, you will ensure that service deliveries are executed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with agreed quality, cost, and time requirements.

You will coordinate resources, manage stakeholders, and oversee project execution from planning through completion. Through close collaboration with customers, technicians, project teams, and internal functions, you will ensure a structured and professional approach to service delivery.

The role requires both a customer-oriented and commercially minded approach, as you will be expected to identify opportunities for optimization and continuous improvement while maintaining a strong focus on customer satisfaction. Your technical expertise will enable you to provide valuable support and guidance throughout project execution, ensuring that solutions meet both customer expectations and business objectives.

Your Profile

You have a technical background combined with strong project management capabilities and a passion for delivering value to customers. We imagine that you have a background as a Technical Project Manager, Marine Engineer, Project Manager, or similar. You are comfortable working in an international environment and have demonstrated your ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining focus on quality and results.

As a person, you are proactive, solution-oriented, and thrive in a role where customer interaction is a natural part of everyday work. You enjoy taking ownership of your responsibilities and have a strong ability to build trusting relationships with customers as well as colleagues across the organization.

You possess strong communication and stakeholder management skills and are able to navigate effectively between technical discussions and commercial considerations. At the same time, you are driven by creating structure, improving processes, and ensuring successful project delivery.

What we offer:

At ENABL, you will join a company with excellent opportunities for professional and personal development. We offer attractive employee benefits, competitive salary based on qualifications, flexible work arrangements, and a collaborative environment where you will work alongside highly skilled specialists within mechanics, electrical engineering, software, and project management.

The place of work is Kilde Allé 4, 8722 Hedensted

Questions and application:

If you have questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Director Global Service, Jonas Graabæk Jensen at JOJE@enabl.dk.

Interviews will be held on an ongoing basis, as we are looking to fill the position as soon as possible. We look forward to receiving your application and CV in either Danish or English.

More About Us

ENABL A/S is a specialized engineering company the wind industry delivering Advanced Equipment Solutions and Engineering Services within wind turbine development, production, transportation, installation, and service. ENABL is a trusted partner to Developers, OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers worldwide.

Founded in Denmark, we build our business on our core values: quality, persistance, innovation, responsibility, and alliances. With more than 25 years of experience and a proven track record, ENABL delivers critical solutions across the entire value chain of the wind industry. Our Lifting Equipment, designed to reduce installation time, has been used for over 50% of offshore blades installed globally, excluding China. Our Production Equipment, which boosts productivity, is deployed in more than 50 wind turbine factories worldwide. Through our Engineering Services, we support innovation across the sector, contributing to the development of over 20 different turbine platforms ranging from 2 to 20 MW.

As part of the Eltronic Group, ENABL draws on the expertise of over 1,600 colleagues, combining deep technical knowledge, advanced technologies, and industry insight. ENABL is located across the world and has established a global track record with over 12,000 projects. ENABL’s purpose is to be the partner of choice, enabling the green transition.

**The Impact You'll Make

**Do you enjoy turning complex technical data into insights that drive better products and smarter decisions? Are you passionate about combining data science with engineering and domain expertise to solve real-world challenges? Then this could be the opportunity for you.

As our Lead Engineer, Data Science, you’ll play a key role in transforming product, sensor and operational data into meaningful insights that support innovation, energy efficiency and data-driven decision-making across Danfoss Climate Solutions.

Working closely with business teams, engineers and data platform specialists, you’ll combine strong analytical capabilities with engineering and domain knowledge to identify high-value opportunities, shape AI and analytics use cases and help build a robust, AI-ready data foundation for future intelligent solutions.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Translate complex business and engineering challenges into analytical questions, data-driven models and actionable insights

• Analyze product, sensor, device and operational data to identify patterns, trends and opportunities for performance and energy optimization

• Apply engineering and domain knowledge to shape high-value data science and AI use cases, including feature definition, hypothesis development and validation strategies

• Collaborate with data engineers and platform teams to improve data quality, accessibility and usability across analytics and data products

• Contribute to semantic models and knowledge graph capabilities that capture relationships between sensors, devices, assets and their operational context

• Communicate insights and recommendations clearly to technical and business stakeholders, helping turn analytical findings into practical business actions

**What We're Looking For

**

• Strong foundation in thermodynamics and physics, with the ability to apply first-principles reasoning to heating and cooling systems and processes

• Experience in data science, applied analytics or similar roles within a technical, industrial or engineering environment

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with proficiency in Python and SQL and the ability to translate engineering insight into data-driven models

• Good understanding of modern data and ML environments, including cloud platforms and the machine learning lifecycle

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, data and business teams

• Experience with HVAC, refrigeration, heating/cooling, energy systems or industrial operational data is considered a strong advantage

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like 13th salary, annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**What Makes Us, Us

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-cantered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US At SimCorp we believe AI plays a pivotal role in the futures success of our company. To facilitate the use of AI, we have created an Enterprise AI team, which is responsible for creating AI agents in our infrastructure, setting up MCP connectors and providing the infrastructure and AI tools for the organization. As a Lead IT Operation Specialist, you will be responsible for ensuring the smooth operation and optimization of our agents and our AI-related systems and services. This role involves setting up AI agents and MCP connectors as well as and managing IT infrastructure and services, monitoring system performance, and resolving technical issues. The Lead IT Operation Specialist works closely with cross-functional IT teams to ensure that IT operations support business objectives, maintain high system availability, and meet security standards.

What You Will Be Responsible For

• Own intake of AI agents and automations built in the organization into our managed infrastructure

• Maintain the portfolio of AI agents and automations, ensuring cost control, reliability, effective monitoring, and resolution of complex issues

• Build and maintain MCP connectors to enable effective use of AI tools across the organization

• Support the monitoring, management, and optimization of our AI-related IT infrastructure and services to ensure high performance, security, and availability

• Develop and implement IT operational processes in the Enterprise AI area to ensure efficient operations and incident resolution, and support the transition of routine tasks to the Operations Center

• Ensure our AI-related agents and connectors complies with security policies, procedures, and industry regulations, including guardrails such as Azure Policies and Copilot Studio guidelines

• Collaborate with business units and our AI Enablement team to ensure seamless end-to-end execution across teams and business function boundaries

• Provide lead guidance and drive a collaborative, results-oriented environment for junior IT operations specialists

**Type of work this role engages with

**

• Managing and optimizing IT systems and services to support business operations

• Leading the diagnosis and resolution of complex IT operational issues

• Developing and implementing IT operations processes to improve efficiency and service delivery

• Coaching team members and advancing ongoing improvements in IT operations

**What We Value

**

• Hands-on experience with Claude, Copilot Studio or similar AI orchestration platforms, and an understanding of how to configure, monitor, and maintain AI tools at scale

• Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or API integration patterns — you understand how to connect AI assistants like Microsoft Copilot and Claude to enterprise systems

• A solid grasp of IT operations fundamentals: monitoring, incident management, availability, cost control, and service reliability

• Experience with AI agent lifecycle management — from intake and onboarding through to ongoing monitoring and decommissioning

• Comfort working across security and compliance boundaries, including implementing guardrails and ensuring adherence to policies and regulations

• Strong cross-functional collaboration skills — you work effectively across engineering, business, and enablement teams and can translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders

• An interest in or understanding of AI governance frameworks — you appreciate why guardrails matter and can implement them practically, not just in principle

**Benefits

**An attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work & life balance and opportunities for professional development: there is never just one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take. Visit our career pages to learn more about working at SimCorp: www.simcorp.com/career. Since SimCorp operates in 20+ offices worldwide, the benefits package may vary from country to country.

Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

For any questions, you are welcome to contact Katkat Calimag-Rupera, Senior Talent Acquisition Partner, at email katkat.rupera@simcorp.com. will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds in general.

We're looking for a senior AI engineer with hands-on experience in generative AI, API integrations, and advanced agent-based applications. The ideal candidate brings a mix of full-stack, AI, and cloud engineering experience.

**What You'll Do

**This role cuts across multiple tech stacks and is a central part of how we deliver AI solutions for our clients.

**In This Role, You'll

**

• Translating early ideas into working prototypes and iterating them into production-ready solutions using modern full-stack frameworks

• Designing and deploying generative AI applications and autonomous agents using LLM APIs and established agent frameworks

• Integrating AI capabilities into client systems and managing deployment pipelines in cloud environments

• Collaborating with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to build solutions that address real needs

• Mentoring junior engineers and keeping pace with emerging AI and software engineering paradigms

**Beyond That, You'll Bring

**

• Full-stack capability across TypeScript (React, Next.js, Vite) and Python, with experience shipping production systems

• Hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph, CrewAI, Agno, or DSPy

• Proficiency with RESTful APIs, cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP), and containerisation tools such as Docker and Kubernetes

Relevant AI or cloud certifications are a plus. English is our corporate language; however, proficiency in one or more additional languages is a plus for this role.

**What We Offer

**You'll join a fast-growing team backed by Implement Consulting Group — nerdy by nature, genuinely curious about both technology and people, and serious about craft. You'll have real autonomy, a strong culture of learning, and meaningful AI challenges across industries.

Ready to shape the digital future with us? We review applications on an ongoing basis and will close the role once filled, so apply ASAP.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**About The Tech Collective

**The Tech Collective is a fast-growing consulting company powered by Implement. We help organisations unlock the immense potential of data, AI and analytics, ensuring that they are fit for the digital future. Through co-creation and passionate advisory, we aim to make our clients’ data easy to handle and provide useful insights.

In our collective, you will find people with a combination of nerdiness and infectious energy. We are passionate about technology, but we also have a sincere interest in people.

_Do you want to shape how the world’s largest dedicated fund manager within greenfield renewable energy uses AI to deploy capital? If so, CIP Fund Solutions (CIP FS) is looking for a Product Manager to join our Digital & AI team in Copenhagen, Denmark.

_**Team

**As Product Manager, you will join the Digital & AI team in CIP Fund Solutions, reporting to the Investment Lifecycle Lead. You will be part of a new delivery unit, developing and rolling out digital and AI solutions that will bring efficiency to CIP’s investment teams.

**Role

**Behind every investment decision at CIP sit data rooms, contracts, financial models and investment committee materials. As Product Manager, you will find where AI saves the investment teams the most time or improves their decisions and turn that into products they use every day. You will own the AI product roadmap for the investment lifecycle, from identifying use cases through delivery, adoption and measured impact.

**Responsibilities will consist of but are not limited to:

**

• Embed with investment teams to map workflows and quantify where AI adds value.

• Own and prioritize the AI product roadmap for the investment lifecycle.

• Turn business problems into requirements, success metrics and acceptance criteria for engineering.

• Prototype and demo concepts with users before committing engineering capacity.

• Drive adoption and report impact in time saved, cycle time and usage.

• Assess external AI vendors against internal build options, and make sure solutions meet CIP’s security, data protection and responsible AI requirements.

**You

**You have a master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Finance, Economics or a related field, and bring 5-8 years of experience in product management, management consulting, technology delivery or an investment role.

You have a track record of taking data or AI products from problem definition to adoption by business users, and working knowledge of LLMs, AI agents and retrieval-based solutions. You are technically fluent (basic Python or SQL, APIs, AI prototyping tools) and can build demos and work credibly with engineers. Experience from infrastructure, private equity, project finance or energy is considered beneficial.

**We look for the following in a candidate:

**

• Solid stakeholder management and the credibility to challenge senior investment professionals.

• Clear, concise communication, with the ability to explain complex topics simply.

• Structured and commercially minded, with a focus on where AI creates the most value.

• Ownership of ambiguous problems and the drive to see solutions through to adoption.

**The process

**Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

---

**CIP Fund Solutions’ commitment to diversity and inclusion

**CIP Fund Solutions is committed to securing a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels respected and heard.

A diverse workforce allows CIP Fund Solutions to achieve results through different approaches and solutions to task execution and problem solving. We want all our employees to have equal opportunities for personal growth and career opportunities regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion, nationality, or ethnicity.

**CIP Fund Solutions

**CIP FS’ purpose is to enable CIP’s ambition to scale rapidly over the coming strategy-period - supporting our colleagues with professional and efficient financial, legal, tax and business operations through the cycle from fund formation and capital raising, to deploying investments into construction of large-scale greenfield renewable energy assets, as well as M&A.

For more information, please visit CIP Fund Solutions.

jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

**The Opportunity

As our Global Skills & Talent Intelligence Product Owner, you'll shape how employees discover opportunities, build skills, and develop their careers. **

• Define and execute the strategy and roadmap for Skills and Talent Intelligence products.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

**EY | Building a better working world

**EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

The Opportunity

Veo runs on a fast-growing estate of devices, SaaS tools and offices across Copenhagen, Berlin and Miami. As the first operational IT security hire, you'll own the security of that environment: the devices our people use, the identities and access that connect them to our tools, and how we respond when something goes wrong.

This isn't a "follow the runbook" role. You'll sit in our IT team, assess where we are today, set the direction, and build the processes and tooling that keep Veo secure as we scale.

What You Will Do

• 
You'll be hands-on across endpoint, identity, and operational security, and you'll be the go-to person for IT security across the business.

• 
Own endpoint security across our macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS and Android devices, including EDR, MDM, patching, encryption and hardening baselines

• 
Define and enforce our BYOD approach, using conditional access, device compliance checks and data separation so people can work flexibly without putting company data at risk

• 
Run SSO, SCIM and MFA across our SaaS applications, and own onboarding and offboarding so access is granted and removed on time, every time.

• 
Build identity governance, including regular access reviews, least-privilege access, and clear ownership of who has access to what

• 
Lead IT incident response from detection and triage through containment, investigation and post-incident review, and keep our playbooks sharp

• 
Monitor and respond to CVEs affecting our endpoints and SaaS tools, assessing risk, prioritizing fixes, and making sure patches are applied on time

• 
Plan and run phishing simulations and security awareness training that change behavior, and measure the results

• 
Drive day-to-day operational security, including alert monitoring, vulnerability management, SaaS vendor assessments, and keeping policies and runbooks current

• 
Lead our IT security work for GDPR and NIS2, from implementing controls to maintaining documentation and evidence, together with Legal and GRC

• 
Help lay the groundwork for future SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certification

• 
Own our office security systems, such as CCTV and door access, working with our Office Manager

What You Could Bring

• 
You've likely spent several years in IT security or security operations, ideally in a growing tech company, and you're comfortable being the person who owns security end-to-end.

That experience tends to show up in several of the following:

• 
Endpoint and device security: hands-on with EDR and MDM tools such as CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Hexnode, Intune or Kandji, across desktop and mobile, including securing BYOD environments

• 
Identity and access: deep experience with Google Workspace and Entra rolling out SSO, SCIM, and MFA, and running joiner/mover/leaver processes and access reviews.

• 
Incident response: you've led real incidents end-to-end and can stay calm and clear under pressure.

• 
Vulnerability management: you track CVEs, judge real-world risk quickly, and get fixes rolled out.

• 
Security culture: you've run phishing awareness programs and can explain risk in plain language to people who aren't technical.

• 
Compliance in practice: you've applied GDPR and NIS2 requirements in an operational role. Experience with SOC 2 or ISO 27001 is a strong advantage as we work towards them.

• 
Linux: administration and hardening experience is highly valued.

Nice To Have

• 
Scripting and automation (Python, PowerShell, Bash)

• 
SIEM experience

• 
Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, OSCP, or GIAC

How We Work

You'll be part of the IT team within Administration & Finance and work most closely with GRC, the Security Enablement Team, and Legal. We're pragmatic; we prioritize what matters most, and we favor simple solutions that help people work securely without slowing them down.

If you match on several of these areas but not all, apply anyway. We care more about how you think and what you'll own than about ticking every box.

Our Copenhagen office mirrors our innovative technology – with an indoor ball court, rooftop terrace, and well-equipped gym. We have created a facility that supports connecting disciplines across the business, facilitates creative thinking, and gives the space to engage with colleagues, our global partners, and the entire Veo community.

Values we hold at Veo:

Dare - We take initiative, stay curious, and challenge the status quo in our work.

Own it - We drive impact by identifying opportunities, taking responsibility, and confidently executing.

Level up - We embrace growth, continuously learning and shaping our skills.

Play as a team - We collaborate across a diverse organization, leveraging shared insights for stronger

outcomes.

Customer Centric - We deliver value by having close partnerships and a deep understanding of our customers (internally and externally)

We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, even if your experience doesn’t completely match every qualification listed. What matters most is your creativity, potential, and ability to make meaningful contributions.

We want to enable all teams around the world recording their football matches without the obstacles of finding a cameraman. Democratizing football, by giving access to video analysis, that in the past only were available for the few. The innovative dual-lense camera technology records the entire pitch at all times, with two 4K high resolution sports action lenses. Our intelligent software automatically follows the ball to create a broadcast view, while allowing you the controls with a simple click of you mouse. Our solution is developing better athletes. We’re looking for a commercially minded Legal Counsel to join us on our journey to become one stronger, more integrated SaaS business. You’ll work across commercial contracts, privacy and cybersecurity in the European and North American market, partnering with colleagues across the organisation to find practical solutions and support our growth.

Reporting to our General Counsel, you’ll work at the intersection of commercial law, privacy, cybersecurity and business transformation. You’ll play a key role in enabling business growth, supporting complex customer deals, and ensuring that our legal commitments are practical, proportionate and aligned with how we operate.

Whether you’re building on your experience in private practice or looking to grow further in an in-house role, this is an opportunity for you to take ownership, learn along the way, and make a real difference.

We are open to on-site (offices in Copenhagen and Wrocław), hybrid, and remote working within two time zones of our offices (CET), plus the US East Coast.

**About Us

**Cookie Information, Piwik PRO, and Sheltr, are leading SaaS brands specialising in privacy-first compliance and analytics. Together, we’re building intuitive, user-friendly products that help organisations navigate data privacy and marketing insights. With headquarters in Copenhagen and an office in Wrocław, our teams have been working across various industries to build trusted data privacy solutions since 2011.

We’re bringing our brands closer together to build one company with a shared identity in the group, a clear focus and ambitious plan for the future. The Legal, Compliance and Cybersecurity team has a core role to play in making that happen.

The role

These will be your main tasks:

Handle commercial contracts, particularly sales contracts

• Draft, review and negotiate customer contracts for EU and US customers.

• Support partner, reseller and supplier agreements, as well as more specialised regulatory requirements such as DORA-related terms and US healthcare BAAs.

• Work closely with Sales and Account Management to find solutions that support our commercial goals while managing legal risks.

Privacy compliance and cybersecurity

• Support GDPR compliance, international data transfers, sub-processor management and relevant UK and US privacy requirements.

• Work with our Cybersecurity team on NIS2 compliance and related contractual requirements.

• Help our Cyber Security and Compliance teams to respond to customer privacy and security questionnaires, audits and due diligence requests.

• Advise Product teams on privacy, consent and data protection, helping ensure that our commitments reflect how we actually work.

Help shape the way we work

• Improve legal templates, processes and ways of working as the business grows.

• Collaborate with colleagues across Sales, Product, Security, Finance and Operations.

• Contribute to shaping our legal function and how we support the wider business.

**About You

**You’re a structured, independent, and commercially minded lawyer who enjoys working with people and finding practical solutions. You combine sound legal judgement with a practical understanding of how a business operates. You’re comfortable challenging assumptions, thinking creatively and making decisions, even when the answer isn’t entirely straightforward.

You know that good legal advice is not just about identifying risks; it’s about helping the business understand those risks and finding a way forward.

You bring:

• 2-5 years of experience with commercial contracts, gained in-house or at a law firm.

• An understanding of B2B contracting and an interest in SaaS or technology businesses.

• Working knowledge of GDPR and privacy law in a commercial context, or relevant experience with HIPAA and US privacy law.

• The ability to communicate clearly, and comfortable working directly with Sales on live deals and making pragmatic judgement calls.

• Fluency in English (C2).

Nice-to-haves

• Experience with cybersecurity regulations (NIS2 and/or DORA).

• Experience with HIPAA, including negotiating BAAs.

• Knowledge of corporate governance, employment/HR legal matters (DK, PL, DE, and/or US).

• Experience with US customers and US commercial contracting, including state privacy laws and/or wiretap/tracking litigation risk.

• Experience building processes and templates in a growing legal function.

What we offer

• The opportunity to make a real impact. You’ll help shape a growing international SaaS business as it evolves towards a more integrated, enterprise-ready organisation. You won’t simply be maintaining existing processes; you’ll help develop the legal and commercial foundations for our next stage of growth.

• International exposure and commercial ownership. You’ll work on customer and partner relationships across the US and Europe, gaining exposure to complex commercial negotiations and a broad range of legal and regulatory challenges.

• The chance to broaden your expertise, take ownership of meaningful projects and grow with the business.

• Professional development budget, health insurance, and other benefits.

• A positive, informal workplace.

Application process

We’re looking to fill the position as soon as possible and will be inviting candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so don’t hesitate to send your application today.

This is what our recruitment process looks like:

• A brief screening call with our Talent Partner (online, approx. 30 mins)

• An in-depth interview with the General Counsel and a stakeholder from the company (online)

• A final interview with our General Counsel including a live case (online or in-person, TBD)

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

At Cookie Information & Piwik PRO we value diversity as a cornerstone of our success. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability. We recognise that certain groups are underrepresented in the tech industry, and we encourage everyone to apply and help us shape a more inclusive workspace.

With an IoT platform connecting more than 6 million units — and growing — Trackunit is building the platform that will enable the construction industry to work faster, smarter, and more securely. And we need you to help run and scale it.

As an SRE, you will join our Europe-based team and be part of a global SRE organization spanning Europe and Canada. This is a hands-on role focused on the daily operation and continuous improvement of our platform, with room to grow into larger design and architecture work as you build depth.

The platform owned by SRE consists of an AWS cloud, Kubernetes clusters (EKS), and our IaC setup running Terraform and Terramate, as well as a GitOps delivery platform built on Argo CD and Atlantis.

We support engineering teams with 150+ developers. You will help keep a platform used by 15,000+ active users every day secure, available, and easy to build on.

We're looking for someone curious and collaborative — happy to share knowledge and ask questions as well.

Experience level: roughly 2–5 years in an SRE, DevOps, platform, or infrastructure operations role. If you're further along and the day-to-day scope appeals to you, apply anyway — we'll have the conversation.

With locations in the heart of Copenhagen, Kolding, Aarhus, and Aalborg, we offer a flexible setup with the possibility to work from one of our locations — or remotely from anywhere in Denmark.

**What's in it for you?

**

• International environment with regular check-ins and social events across teams, departments and borders.

• We take your personal and professional development goals seriously and we support them through training, coaching, and mindfulness as well as with an open feedback culture to enable you to identify your strengths and opportunities.

• Flexibility and hybrid working is not just a cliché to us or something we state in a job posting. We offer a flexible setup because we believe you know best how to structure your work. Once you have chosen how you work best, let us know what you need: we got you covered with the IT equipment you need for your work.

• Turning the Tide. At Trackunit, we aim to create and contribute to an inclusive workplace. And this priority starts with our hiring — we do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity, sexual orientation, personal expression, ethnicity, religious belief, or disability status. We only assess candidates on their qualifications and merit. Learn more about TIDE and other DE&I initiatives here.

**What You'll Do

**Your week will be a mix of keeping things running well and making them better.

• Operate and improve the platform. Monitoring, alerting, capacity, cost, and the steady stream of small improvements that keep a large AWS and Kubernetes estate healthy.

• Work in code, not consoles. Infrastructure changes go through Terraform and Helm, reviewed as pull requests and delivered through Atlantis and Argo CD.

• Keep the platform secure. Patching, vulnerability remediation, base image updates, and closing findings — a recurring, meaningful part of the job rather than a side task.

• Take part in incident response. You'll join our on-call rotation (SRE team, business hours) and contribute to incidents and follow-up work.

• Handle triage and requests from developer teams. Understanding what they need, unblocking them, and spotting when a repeated request could be automated.

**Who You Are

**We think you'll need

• Hands-on experience running workloads on AWS.

• Basic knowledge with Kubernetes.

• Basic knowledge about infrastructure as code, ideally Terraform.

• Comfortable with Git, Linux and Windows.

• Clear written communication — a lot of our work happens in tickets, PRs, and docs.

**Nice to have, not expected

**

• EKS specifically, or tooling like Karpenter, Argo CD, Atlantis, or Terramate.

• Observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Sumo Logic, or similar).

• Scripting in Python or Go.

• Security or compliance work — vulnerability management, CIS benchmarks, certification programmes.

• Multi-region or multi-account AWS architecture.

**What Matters More Than The Checklist

**

• You’re curious and self-driven, while also knowing when to ask for help when needed.

• You finish things. Small, well-tested changes shipped consistently beat big ideas that stall.

• You care about the developers and customers using the platform, not just the platform itself.

On AI: experience with AI tooling is not a requirement. An interest in working with it is. We already use AI in our daily engineering work — including MCP servers and agents against our own platform — and we expect that to grow. We don’t expect you to have experience with this—but we do expect curiosity and a willingness to learn.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries — this is what we're looking for ideally, but if you're excited about this role and your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we still encourage you to apply.

**How You'll Grow Here

**We hire at this level expecting you to move beyond it, and we've structured the team so that happens on purpose rather than by accident.

• A rotation model that protects your focus. The team splits between operational duty and project work, so you're not permanently interrupt-driven. You get real blocks of time to go deep on something.

• Mentorship that's built in. Senior colleagues review your PRs and pair with you on incidents. Asking questions is the expected behaviour, not a sign you're struggling.

• Exposure to the big architecture work. You'll start with scoped pieces and take on more as you build context.

• A clear conversation about your development. Regular 1:1s that cover where you want to be, not just what you shipped last sprint.

**What We're Building Next

**Trackunit is moving from a SaaS company to a platform built on telemetry data from the construction industry worldwide. For SRE, that means going beyond delivering infrastructure to building the capabilities that let our developers and customers spin up environments tailored to their needs in the regions they need them.

Things on our roadmap include:

• Expanding the platform into a true multi-region architecture.

• Building self-service platform capabilities so developer teams move at their own pace.

• Making better use of AI in our own operations, through MCP servers and agents.

You won't be expected to lead these on day one. You will be in the room, and there will be pieces with your name on them.

**What Happens From Here — Recruitment Process Overview

**

• Virtual meet and greet. Meet with a member of our Talent Partner team

• Personality-based interview. You will be asked to complete an online personality assessment prior to the interview. There are no correct answers and we are not trying to categorise you — the aim is a dialogue about the results and Trackunit's culture, so you get to know us better as well.

• Assignment-specific interview. You will be given a case to prepare after the initial screening interview. You will present the case to relevant colleagues across Trackunit, who you will also work closely with in the role.

• Virtual meet and greet. Meet with Engineering Manager, Kåre Brandborg and an SRE team member.

• References and background checks (if needed). If required, we will obtain references from former employers and perform level-specific background checks, if you have not provided these yourself.

• Offer presentation and walk-through. We're lucky to have you!

**Coming Together To Connect Construction

**We're committed to construction — one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products — it's a way of life at Trackunit. We're proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues get together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do it to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

jobs.description:
If you’re energised by driving lean transformation at a company level and you thrive on turning complex challenges into tangible business impact, we’d love to hear from you!

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Lean Consultant to join our team of highly skilled colleagues in the Project Excellence department. In Project Excellence, we act as internal consultants grounded in Lean, supporting projects and leadership across NNE by strengthening performance management, structured problem solving and continuous improvement practices.

As a Senior Lean Consultant, you will work closely with project organisations and leaders to set direction for improvement initiatives, build Lean capabilities and drive performance. At the same time, you will take an active, hands-on role in facilitating problem solving and implementing improvements on our most critical projects, ensuring that ideas translate into real impact.

This role offers a unique opportunity to operate at the intersection of leadership, Lean transformation and project execution, contributing to building a strong and sustainable performance and improvement culture across NNE.

You’ll be based in our Virum Office, but the role requires you to visit our project sites in Kalundborg and around the Copenhagen area on a regular basis.

How you might spend your days

As a Senior Lean Consultant, you’ll be:

• Helping the Project Excellence department set direction for continuous improvement and Lean in NNE, aligned with NNE’s strategy

• Building Lean capabilities by developing and embedding structured problem solving, lean project management and continuous improvement practices

• Designing and delivering training in Lean tools, Lean principles and Lean ways of working across NNE

• Coaching leaders and teams to strengthen performance management and Lean leadership behaviours

• Facilitating and driving structured problem-solving on major projects, using A3 thinking as our core approach

• Advising on consistent implementation of improvements, ensuring solutions are anchored and deliver real impact

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• Passionate about Lean thinking and driven to create real lasting business impact

• Confident in engaging, challenging and developing leaders and teams at all levels

• Comfortable operating in complex environments, bringing clarity, structure and direction

• Pragmatic and execution-focused with a great drive to turn ideas into results

• A credible role model who takes ownership and leads by example

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• Extensive experience driving continuous improvement and lean transformations in complex organisations

• Proven ability to lead and implement change with measurable impact

• Solid experience working closely with senior leaders on performance and improvement agendas

• A relevant academic degree at Master level

• Excellent facilitation, coaching and stakeholder management skills across organisational levels

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference.
